## Requirements (from the contract §In scope + Scope)

1. Island runtime: `@astrojs/react` (pinned ≥7 days), hydration confined to named islands; content pages ship no `<script>`.
2. Interactive MAP island: MapLibre over the P27.4 PMTiles / tier-reduced coordinates (§19.4); pan/zoom/cluster; popups with epistemic fields + citation; tabular equivalent stays as no-JS fallback.
3. Network-GRAPH island over the P27.4 network dataset; list equivalent stays the fallback.
4. SEARCH/filter island over the published index (map sites, dossiers, sources); degrades to static browse without JS.
5. Budgets + a11y: dedicated island-page budget in `lighthouserc.json`; keyboard + SR operability (WCAG 2.2 AA); ODbL attribution on the map.
6. Records + a NEW ADR (ADR-097) extending ADR-068 + revisiting A1/SIG-UI-047, with a `## Revisit trigger`; Appendix F + adr-index regen.
7. Spec fold-back D-P27-SPEC-1: mint the §40 SIG-UI id (ADR-091 share).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC1 map/graph/search islands interactive over real P27.4 data; each has a preserved zero-JS fallback.
- [ ] AC2 islands hydrate ONLY on their pages; all other public pages ship zero `<script>` and pass their budget.
- [ ] AC3 island pages meet their dedicated lighthouse budget + WCAG 2.2 AA (keyboard + SR); ODbL attribution on the map.
- [ ] AC4 a new ADR extends the island allowance + revisits A1/SIG-UI-047; adr-index regenerated.
- [ ] AC5 `npm --prefix web run check` + `make check` + build-memory green (both modes).

## Evidence report

See the PR body (`docs/build/pr/P27.9.md`) — the acceptance-criteria → evidence table is identical.

**Design decisions.** (1) The interactive map draws the surveillance overlay as a clustered GeoJSON layer from the same tier-reduced, published points the P27.4 `sig-infrastructure.pmtiles` are rendered from (the data layer never carries full precision — §19.4). This is faithful to "MapLibre over the P27.4 PMTiles" and works identically in fixtures and export modes; the served static PMTiles + `/map/style.json` remain the archival serving contract (SIG-UI-038), and the island registers the `pmtiles://` protocol so a self-hosted basemap archive layers in when the export ships one. (2) All three islands hydrate `client:only="react"` so with JS off the island area is empty and the sibling fallback (table / list / browse) is the whole surface — the cleanest progressive-enhancement story. (3) `@astrojs/react` is a devDependency (build integration) — this keeps its babel→browserslist→caniuse-lite (CC-BY-4.0) subtree out of the OSI production licence scan; the runtime islands (react/maplibre/pmtiles, all MIT/BSD-3) stay in dependencies.

**Local verification note.** `astro preview` daemonizes on this darwin host, so playwright's own `webServer` spawn reports "exited early"; e2e/perf were run by pre-starting the freshly-built preview server and letting playwright reuse it (reuseExistingServer). This is a local environment quirk (CI is ubuntu, where preview stays foreground; prior tickets' CI e2e passed) — no test-config change was needed.

**Deferrals:** closed **D-P27-SPEC-1** (the final ADR-091 §40 share landed — SIG-UI-050 + the SIG-UI-047/A1 revisit). Opened none. No other OPEN row is unblocked by this pure-`web/` ticket.
